svg.text: ULTRA-LONG CONTEXT (128K–1M) LLM ARCHITECTURE: HYBRID CP & TIERED KV OFFLOAD
2D Hybrid USP (Ulysses × Ring CP) + Tiered Host DRAM/GDS KV Pool Cuts 128K TTFT 12.3x
32x H200 Running 128K Context: Tier 1 TP=8 Only (28.4s TTFT, $3.40/1M) vs. Tier 4 USP + KV Pool (2.3s TTFT, $0.58/1M)
⛔ Tier 1 Traps: Quadratic Prefill & HBM KV Thrashing
1. Quadratic O(S²) Attention Overwhelms Single-Node TP=8:
• Once context S > 12 * d_model (~96K), Self-Attention FLOPs exceed
MLP linear projections, pushing 128K Prefill TTFT to 28.4 seconds!
2. Pure Ulysses CP Hits the GQA KV-Head Ceiling (`n_kv = 8`):
• DeepSpeed-Ulysses partitions Attention heads via All-to-All, so
GQA-8 models cannot scale Ulysses beyond 8 GPUs without KV copy
3. Multi-Turn 128K KV Eviction Triggers Full Recompute:
• 128K GQA FP8 KV = 21.0 GB/session; HBM eviction wastes 28s!
Tier 1 Single-Node TP=8 Failure Impact (128K Context):
• P95 128K TTFT: 28.4 sec | P99 Decode TPOT: 62.5 ms
• Effective Prefix KV Cache Hit Rate: Only 18.5%
• Effective Cost per 1M 128K-Context Tokens: $3.40 / 1M
🏆 Tier 4: 2D Hybrid USP + Tiered Host DRAM/GDS KV Pool
1. 2D Hybrid USP (`Intra-Node Ulysses × Inter-Node Ring CP`):
• Runs Ulysses All-to-All over 900 GB/s NVLink (`Ulysses=8`) and
Ring P2P overlapped with FlashAttention over 400G RDMA (`Ring=4`)
2. 3-Tier KV Offload (`L1 HBM <-> L2 Pinned DRAM <-> L3 NVMe GDS`):
• Recalling 21 GB KV over PCIe Gen5 (`512 GB/s/node`) takes `41ms`
vs. `28,400ms` full Prefill recompute (`692x` faster recall!)
3. Consistent Prefix-Tree Routing (`Mooncake / LMCache`):
• Shares 2 TB/node DDR5 DRAM KV pool across cluster over RDMA
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks (128K Context):
• Effective Multi-Turn KV Cache Hit Rate: 91.4%
• Effective Cost per 1M Tokens: $0.58 / 1M (-82.9% savings)
